'''Slyther Bushforb'''<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|url=status/1487690195877064705|name=[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|date=2022-01-27|quote=These are two Podracer models re-dressed and repurposed as new characters. Ark "Bumpy" Roose is now Slyther Bushforb, and Ebe Endicott is Oby Bobissia. A CG Mars Guo re-dress was planned but never made it to screen.|archivedate=20220205184303}}</ref> was a [[Color|blue]]-skinned [[Nuknog]] that spoke animatedly with the [[Triffian]]<ref name="AOTC" /> [[Oby Bobissia]]<ref name="Twitter" /> outside<ref name="AOTC" /> [[Dex's Diner]] in the [[CoCo Town]] district of the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]<ref name="SWCL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> in [[22 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY]].</ref> After the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] entered the diner, Bushforb followed him in and then sat in a both with the [[Dug]]s<ref name="AOTC" /> [[Rednax]]<ref name="Rednax">{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|url=status/1487690415738261508|name=[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|date=2022-01-30|quote=The Sebulba and Ratts Tyerell re-dresses became Sedoca / Rednax and Bogg Tyrell, and are seen in the Coruscant speeder chase and in the diner as well.|archivedate=20220205184303}}</ref> and [[Seboca]], the latter of whom was a [[holovid]] [[Actor|star]].<ref name="SWCL" /> The trio spoke until Seboca got up and left the diner, after which Bushforb and Rednax continued to converse. While at the diner, Bushforb wore a white [[Clothing|shirt]], a brown [[Jacket|coat]], brown pants, and black shoes.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Slyther Bushforb was created for the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]<ref name="AOTC" /> on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="Yby">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> The character was a redressed version of the animated model created for [[Ark Roose]],<ref name="Twitter" /> a character created for the [[1999]] prequel film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> Work on the animated shots in Dex's Diner was completed between [[April]] and [[May]], [[2001]], with the finalized renders then completed over the summer.<ref name="Insider63">{{InsiderCite|63|Behind the Magic}}</ref>

In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Bushforb's name was confirmed by<ref name="Twitter" /> [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member<ref name="SW Show Interview">{{StarWarsShow|GvT2F1j-SvA|Pablo Hidalgo Extended Interview|sw_url=video/pablo-hidalgo-extended-interview}}</ref> [[Pablo Hidalgo]] on [[Wikipedia:Twitter|Twitter]] on [[January 27]], [[2022]].<ref name="Twitter" /> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where [[Slyther Bushforb/Legends|Slyther Bushforb]] was revealed prior to the release of the film in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 46|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #46'']], an<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|jediwatch/1337_1.html|Jedi Refuse to Hand Over Baby Ludi}}</ref> [[March 7]], 2002<ref name="HNN46 date">Per {{JCFCite|url=posts/6042498|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=IAmTheDarkSide|date=2002-03-14|time=5:40 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220914072556/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-4#post-6042498}}, [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 47|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #47]] was released on [[March 14]], [[2002]]. As [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News]] segments were published weekly, and {{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|jediwatch/1337_1.html|Jedi Refuse to Hand Over Baby Ludi}} was published in the issue immediately preceding the forty-seventh edition, it must have been released on [[March 7]] of the same year.</ref> issue published on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News]] website as part of the marketing for the film.<ref name="HNN" /> The article was written by Hidalgo and [[Paul Ens]].<ref name="Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref>
